name: Emanote
description: Emanote is a structured, Obsidian-style notebook and static site generator written in Haskell; it renders a folder of Markdown notes with YAML front matter into a linked site.
notes: Built from the Hackage release with GHC 9.8; the full-text search index is left empty (a stub replaces the Stork binary) and the Tailwind CSS compile step runs as in a normal build.
